source_policy: The retrospective archive supports provisional experiments only. A final archive test never certifies historical declaration timing or contemporaneous rating versions. Current-race SP, RPR, TS, finishing time, margin and comment are excluded from all model features. Same-day results are embargoed from historical features. Final-period results may update later-race history only after the day ends; model parameters and calibration remain frozen.
